implementation: Cmd–Shift–N opens a native New Layer dialog with name, color label, mode, opacity, clipping and neutral fill.
Creation is one undoable command; cancellation and rejected/stale drafts leave the document untouched. Draft guards preserve active-document ownership and block editing/history.

Footer plain-click creates immediately; Option opens options, Command inserts below, and both modifiers open options for below insertion. Group descendants remain contiguous and parent locks/caps are enforced.
PSD lclr color labels are visible in the layer visibility column and survive native/PSD saves without an archive format change; unknown records and reserved bytes are retained.
Mode-neutral sparse fill uses the existing working-space/depth rules, and names choose an unused Layer N.

Exact Photoshop label shades, dialog geometry, numbering/preferences, neutral-fill rounding and high-depth mode restrictions remain unqualified.
Background-specific ordering/locking, advanced group/clipping/HDR behavior, New Group/Duplicate dialogs and complete panel menus remain unfinished.
No Photoshop-wide byte equality, full feature parity, Intel runtime or macOS14 runtime certification is claimed.
